ingress_contract.turn_controller: SecurityDecision PASS plus allowed_input -> normalized TurnRequest

pre_ingress_authorization_contract.turn_n_terminal: after the host_session binding attempt, Validation and Egress emits exactly one TerminalPacket under the originating SecurityDecision: ASK on binding success or provider-caused UNAVAILABLE on binding failure; the host turn then ends
pre_ingress_authorization_contract.evidence_collection: on a new host turn, host_adapter_boundary correlates explicit provider evidence to the still-valid pending request and current evidenced host_session without ordinary routing
pre_ingress_authorization_contract.evaluation: authorization_evaluator returns AuthorizationResult bound to authorization_request_ref
pre_ingress_authorization_contract.reentry: in Turn N+1, AuthorizationResult plus PendingAuthorizationState -> security_restraint -> new SecurityDecision
pre_ingress_authorization_contract.missing_host_session_substrate: the proposed pending interaction remains inactive and non-resumable; Validation and Egress emits terminal UNAVAILABLE under the originating SecurityDecision with owner security_restraint, without ControlDecision or ordinary routing

host_session_state_contract.provider: host_adapter_boundary when the host genuinely supports evidenced cross-turn state
security_rules: the deterministic core never invents host_session state
conversation history or model memory is not a security state store
a returned authorization event is accepted only through provider-evidenced correlation to the outstanding request
absence of evidenced host_session state makes ordinary cross-turn authorization continuation UNAVAILABLE
an unbound proposed PendingAuthorizationState never becomes active or resumable and no future event may correlate to its authorization_request_ref
host_session state is not promoted to durable_external without an explicit continuity operation and receipt

interfaces.name: Model Execution
interfaces.purpose: Generate candidates and structured requests under CTS, ScopeLock, capability, source, and authorization context.

interfaces.name: Host Capability Provider
interfaces.purpose: Translate raw_host_event to raw_host_input, report verified availability separately from declaration, translate generic service requests, and expose evidenced host-session state when genuinely supported without constructing TurnRequest or owning security policy.
required_behavior: scope reports to turn or timestamp
when host_session state is supported, return provider, binding method, state identity, freshness, expiry, and receipt evidence
correlate a returned authorization event to the outstanding request through provider evidence rather than string equality
return UNAVAILABLE when evidenced host_session state is absent
never use model memory or conversation history as a security state store
never own OPSEC, authorization, or attempt policy
interfaces.failure_behavior: UNAVAILABLE or ERROR; security-sensitive cross-turn continuation fails closed

interfaces.name: Time Provider
interfaces.purpose: Supply verified current time and timezone evidence; never perform scheduling by implication.

interfaces.name: Scheduling Provider
interfaces.purpose: Create, update, cancel, and identify future schedules with explicit recurrence semantics.

interfaces.name: Authorization Evidence Provider
interfaces.purpose: Supply explicit identity, credential, role, consent, or policy evidence bound to a safe authorization_request_ref and evidenced host-session request binding when the host can establish it.
required_behavior: accept only ServiceExchange authority_class pre_ingress_authorization with service_id authorization_evidence
require the safe authorization_request_ref and host_session_binding_ref without ordinary ControlDecision authority
limit evaluation to the bound action, resource, and evidence scope
return unavailable when identity or request binding is not established
return AuthorizationResult with evidenced validity_lifetime to security_restraint for pre-ingress re-entry
never dispatch ordinary services under pre-ingress authority
interfaces.failure_behavior: UNAVAILABLE; never infer identity from conversational tone, accept request-ref string equality alone, or bypass security_restraint

interfaces.name: Continuity Provider
interfaces.purpose: Read and write namespaced, versioned continuity with provenance, conflict handling, and durability receipts.
interfaces.failure_behavior: UNAVAILABLE or conflict without fabricated state

interfaces.name: Source and Context Provider
interfaces.purpose: Retrieve allowed source context with source identity, scope, provenance, and verification state.
interfaces.failure_behavior: UNAVAILABLE or partial result with limitations

interfaces.name: Skill and Curriculum Context Provider
interfaces.purpose: Provide optional authorized skill or curriculum context without becoming kernel authority.

interfaces.name: Artifact Provider and Validator
interfaces.purpose: Create or inspect artifacts and return evidence sufficient to validate existence, identity, and requested shape.
required_behavior: return operation and timestamp or turn scope
interfaces.failure_behavior: UNAVAILABLE or ERROR; no success without receipt
